subject: SIG questionnaire — control mapping and evidence delivery (PioneerHealth)
messages:
From: Sara Lin <sara.lin@pioneerhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Reed <ethan.reed@pioneerhealth.com>, procurement@pioneerhealth.com
Date: 2027-11-04T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: SIG questionnaire submission + initial evidence ask

Hi Ben,

Thanks for taking our call earlier. Attached is the SIG questionnaire (v2) for our procurement process — we need a control-level mapping and evidence packet to satisfy the first-round security review. Can you confirm the following by next Tuesday (11/9)?

- A completed control crosswalk (SIG controls -> Redwood controls/processes)
- Primary evidence artifacts for high-risk controls (access control, encryption in transit/at rest, change management, incident response)
- Point of contact for privileged access and SOC 2 report delivery

I attached the questionnaire as "pioneer_SIG_questionnaire_v2.docx" and included a short timeline in the procurement checklist. If you already have a CROSSWALK or an evidence bundle we can review, that would speed things up.

Best,
Sara
Sara Lin
Senior Sourcing Manager | PioneerHealth
Sara.Lin@pioneerhealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lin <sara.lin@pioneerhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-05T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire submission + initial evidence ask

Hi Sara — thanks for the packet. Forwarding to our evidence team and SOC/infosec owners; we'll assemble a crosswalk and a targeted evidence bundle.

Monica / Aditya — can you take lead? Request: produce a control crosswalk (SIG v7.1) mapping to Redwood controls, plus a ZIP of representative artifacts for the following priority controls: 1. Access management (user & service account), 2. Data encryption (in transit & at rest), 3. Change management / deployment approvals, 4. Incident response timelines and recent IR summary, 5. Key management (KMS/HSM note).

Deliverables and dates:
- Draft crosswalk XLSX by 2027-11-06 EOD (Monica)
- Evidence bundle (linkable S3 or Drive folder) by 2027-11-06 EOD (Aditya)
- I'll coordinate with Sara on any redactions and delivery method.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Date: 2027-11-06T17:42:00-08:00
Subject: SIG control crosswalk and evidence bundle (PioneerHealth)

Sara — attaching our deliverables per Ben's note. Quick summary below; full artifacts are in the Drive link and the ZIP attachment.

Attachments: pioneer_sig_crosswalk_20271106.xlsx; s3-evidence-bundle-20271106.zip

Summary highlights (high-risk controls):
- Access Management (SIG ID IAM-01 -> Redwood IAM-Access Policy): included: identity_provisioning_flow.pdf; okta-sso-config-screenshot.png; role_matrix_2027-10.csv
- Encryption (SIG ID ENC-02 -> Redwood Transport & Storage Encryption): included: tls-termination-arch.png; kms-key-rotation-policy.md; SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (redacted PII)
- Change Management (SIG ID CHG-01 -> Redwood Change Approval Process): included: release_runbook_template.md; deployment_approval_jira_filter.png; last_12_months_change_log.xlsx
- Incident Response (SIG ID IR-03 -> Redwood IR Playbook): included: ir-incident-summary-202706.pdf; postmortem-redacted-202709.txt
- KMS / Key Custody: we note that production keys are in AWS KMS with a dual-approval rotation cadence; included key_ownership_matrix.xlsx

Delivery notes and redactions:
- The ZIP contains redacted logs and redaction-notes.txt where we removed customer-identifying information.
- SOC 2 Type II report is included as SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (statement & attestation; detailed tests redacted as per legal guidance).
- If Pioneer needs an attorney-reviewed version of the SOC 2 with the unredacted control tests, we can coordinate an NDA and auditor handoff.

If you want a short walkthrough, I can host a 30-minute evidence tour next week.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Security Evidence Lead | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

From: Sara Lin <sara.lin@pioneerhealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@pioneerhealth.com, Ethan Reed <ethan.reed@pioneerhealth.com>
Date: 2027-11-07T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG control crosswalk and evidence bundle (PioneerHealth)

Monica — thank you, that package looks comprehensive and in the right format. Quick clarifications before I close the loop with procurement: 

1) For the SOC 2 PDF you included, is that a full Type II report or a summary attestation? We need to confirm the period covered (we require coverage that includes at least Q3 2026).
2) For the KMS details: do you have a control owner we can list for our procurement team (name, title, email) for follow-up?

Procurement is also asking whether Redwood has a formal ISO 27001 certification or gap plan; if you have an ISO statement or roadmap, please flag that.

Thanks again — if you can reply by EOD today that will keep us on the timeline.

Best,
Sara

Date: 2027-11-07T11:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG control crosswalk and evidence bundle (PioneerHealth)

Sara — quick answers inline and links below.

1) SOC 2 report: The attached PDF (SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf) is the full Type II attestation covering 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31. We included a redacted copy in the bundle; full test details are available to auditors under an NDA.

2) KMS control owner: Jordan Blake, Director of Platform Security (jordan_blake@redwood.com). He is copied on the internal chain here and can take any technical follow-ups (I also flagged the specific control items to him).

3) ISO 27001: Redwood is not currently ISO 27001 certified. We maintain an ISO readiness roadmap and gap remediation plan; attaching a one-page summary and our expected target window Q3 2028 for certification initiation. If Pioneer requires certification prior to contract execution, we can discuss compensating controls and a certification commitment schedule.

Links / artifacts: 
- Evidence Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cPioneerEvidence
- Redacted SOC 2 (attached): SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf
- Crosswalk XLSX (attached): pioneer_sig_crosswalk_20271106.xlsx

Next steps: Let us know if procurement needs the unredacted SOC 2; Ben and I can coordinate the NDA and auditor exchange. Also happy to run a 30-min walkthrough for your security/IT procurement team next week.

Thanks,
Ben
